title: Hilton Wingback Bed – Traditional Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Hilton Wingback Bed is a traditional upholstered bed frame for anyone who wants a bed with real style, substance and a sense of heritage. Subtly curved winged head and footboards frame the pillows, and it is handmade to order in West Yorkshire in every UK size.

Key features

  • Ornate curved winged headboard and footboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Solid timber frame construction
  • Available in all five UK bed sizes
  • Free fabric swatches before you buy

Sizes

Size Mattress (UK standard) Price
Single (3FT) 90 x 190cm £337.99
Small Double (4FT) 120 x 190cm £363.99
Standard Double (4FT6) 135 x 190cm £376.99
King (5FT) 150 x 200cm £402.99
Super King (6FT) 180 x 200cm £480.99

Measure the wall the bed will sit against, then leave at least 60cm walking space at one side. Check ceiling slopes and low windows before choosing a tall winged headboard.

Materials & build

  • Solid timber frame
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, with custom fabric and colour options available on request
  • Handmade to order in our workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire

Delivery & assembly

Free delivery across Great Britain by our own Eagle Bed team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Want it built for you? Add room-of-choice assembly for £69.99 when you order.

Questions about access, stairs or setting up? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com before you order and we will help.

Warranty & payment

Every bed is backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout, and order free fabric swatches if you would like to see the colours in person first.

Buying guide

What is a wingback bed?

A wingback bed is an upholstered bed frame with tall side panels (wings) angling forward from the headboard, framing the pillows and blocking draughts. The Hilton Wingback has subtly curved winged head and footboards, handmade in West Yorkshire in Single 3ft to Super King 6ft, from £337.99.

Wingback bed vs winged headboard

A winged headboard is the board alone. A wingback bed is the complete frame — headboard, footboard and side rails upholstered to match, so the wings and the base share the same fabric and finish.

Eagle Bed builds both on a solid timber frame, with a 5-year frame warranty and free delivery across Great Britain. If you already own a base, a headboard alone is enough; if you want the whole look, the Hilton Wingback is the full frame.

Wingback, panel or storage?

Wingback — this bed. Tall forward-angled wings for a traditional, enclosed look. From £337.99.

Vertical panel — straight clean lines, no wings: Eagle Mayfair Panel Bed from £311.99.

Wingback with storage — the winged shape on a divan base with drawers: Oxford Wingback Storage Bed from £259.99, or a full gas lift ottoman base from £220.99 (end-lift) and £249.99 (side-lift).

You're viewing: a wingback upholstered frame with no built-in storage.

Pair it with our 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress (from £220.99) or the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress (from £142.99). Browse all Eagle Bed frames.

FAQ

Does the Hilton Wingback have storage?

No. It is a wingback upholstered frame with no built-in storage. For storage, see the Oxford Wingback Storage Bed or our gas lift ottoman bases linked above.

Where is the Hilton Wingback Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid wood frame.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Order free fabric swatches first, or call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com for advice on colours.
